## Facts and statements

- [statement] Allocating inference memory as wired pages on macOS prevents the virtual memory subsystem from paging model weights to swap disks, ensuring consistent sub-millisecond tensor read latencies. (high confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metal/unified_memory_architecture · keywords: Wired Memory Instrumentation and Static Activation Buffers · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad
- [statement] Pre-allocating static activation workspaces at engine startup eliminates dynamic memory allocation overhead and kernel locks during the generation loop. (high confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metal/unified_memory_architecture · keywords: Wired Memory Instrumentation and Static Activation Buffers · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad
